act: Photoreal Bull Moose Wading in a Misty Mountain Lake at Autumn Sunrise
prompt: A photorealistic wildlife photograph of a large bull moose wading knee-deep in a glassy mountain lake at autumn sunrise, wide landscape 16:9. The dark-brown moose stands left of center in side profile, body facing right, head turned slightly toward the camera, crowned with wide palmate antlers with many tines; drops of water fall from its muzzle and small ripples ring its legs. A thin layer of low white mist hangs over the still water. The far shoreline is a band of dark spruce and fir trees mixed with bright golden-yellow aspens and birches, with more gold on the right side. Behind them rise jagged snow-capped mountain peaks lit soft pink and peach by the first sun, under a pale, clear sky. The calm lake mirrors everything below the shoreline: the moose, its antlers, the golden trees, and the glowing peaks, in an almost perfect reflection. Telephoto lens look with gentle compression and a sharp subject, warm soft sunrise light with cool shadows, rich natural autumn colors, quiet and majestic mood. No people, no text, no logos.
